2607.16122.title: CRAFT: Clustering Rubrics to Diagnose Weak LLM Capabilities and Generate Targeted Fine-Tuning Data
2607.16122.paper_summary: Evaluations should do more than measure a models current performance. They should tell us what to fix for the next model iteration and provide a way to generate targeted post training data. Most evaluation pipelines identify weak examples, topics, or categories, but they leave the underlying capability failure implicit: they say where a model fails, not why. We introduce CRAFT, a method that converts any rubric based evaluation dataset into a model specific diagnosis of weak capabilities. CRAFT treats each grading criterion as a capability probe: it extracts a capability description from every prompt rubric pair, clusters these descriptions into a hierarchical capability tree, scores the target model at every node, and selects low performing nodes dynamically across tree levels, at the granularity where each failure is clearest. The selected weak capabilities then direct the generation of targeted supervised finetuning data. Holding the data generation, finetuning, and evaluation setup fixed, we compare CRAFT against prompt level EvalTree clustering and untargeted random generation on four open source models, two professional domains (finance and legal), and 13 held out benchmarks disjoint from the diagnostic data. CRAFT achieves the strongest finance domain average for all four models under repeated temperature decoding; on legal domain, it is strongest for three of four models and remains within the decoding variance bands of the best baseline on the fourth. Diagnosing weaknesses at the level of rubric criteria, rather than prompts or categories, thus yields both a sharper picture of what a model cannot do and measurably better models after finetuning on that diagnosis.
2607.16122.paper_summary_zh: 評估應該不僅僅是測量模型當前的表現。<lb/>它們應該告訴我們下一個模型迭代需要修正的地方，並提供生成針對性後訓練數據的方法。<lb/>大多數評估流程識別出弱的範例、主題或類別，但它們對潛在能力失敗的根本原因卻隱含不明：它們告訴我們模型在哪裡失敗，而不是為什麼失敗。<lb/>我們介紹CRAFT，一種將任何基於標準的評估數據集轉換為模型特定的弱能力診斷的方法。<lb/>CRAFT將每個評分標準視為能力探測器：它從每個提示標準對中提取能力描述，將這些描述聚類成一個分層的能力樹，對目標模型在每個節點進行評分，並在樹的不同層級動態選擇低表現的節點，精確到每個失敗最明顯的層面。<lb/>然後，選定的弱能力指導針對性有監督的微調數據的生成。<lb/>在固定數據生成、微調和評估設置的情況下，我們將CRAFT與提示級EvalTree聚類和無針對性的隨機生成進行比較，涵蓋四個開源模型、兩個專業領域（金融和法律）以及13個與診斷數據不重疊的基準。<lb/>CRAFT在重複的溫度解碼下，為所有四個模型實現了最強的金融領域平均；在法律領域，它在四個模型中有三個是最強的，並且在第四個模型中仍然保持在最佳基準的解碼變異範圍內。<lb/>在標準準則層面診斷弱點，而不是提示或類別，從而提供了模型無法做到的更清晰的圖景，並在基於該診斷的微調後實現了可衡量的更佳模型。
